title: Tracy Base EmDash 0.5.2 passes the readiness rules its personalize map decides (ABOUT-2, ABOUT-3, LANG-1, LANG-2, PAGE-8)
steps: S1: read packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-base package.json, template.config.json, Dockerfile, docs/generated/inventory.json; the tracy-base/emdash-0.x row of apps/tracy-web/src/lib/template-profiles.json; maxVersion of packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/emdash-base.json.

S2: node tools/distribution.mjs pack qa.contract.json <tmp>/pack in the theme; zip it as tracy-base-emdash-quickstart-0.5.2.zip in <tmp>/release beside a tracy_setting.json whose languages are template.config.json locales; node scripts/template-customization-question-readiness.mjs <tmp>/release --tag tracy-base/emdash-0.x --only <rule> --offline --json for ABOUT-2, ABOUT-3, LANG-1, LANG-2, PAGE-8.
S3: node --test tests/personalize-labels, personalize-facts, personalize-rewrite-trade, personalize-gate, empty-claims (cwd the theme).
expect: S1: 0.5.2 in all four places; a template-profiles row 0.5.2; slot maxVersion 0.5.2.

S2: each of the five rules is pass (0.5.1 failed ABOUT-2 with 330 demo pieces, ABOUT-3 with no demoCompanyNames, LANG-2 with only the site entry in labels, LANG-1 and PAGE-8 with no languages in tracy_setting.json).
S3: the suites pass with 0 failures.

selectors.map: packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-base/seed/personalize.json (labels, demoCompanyNames, keptText, copy, blocks, rewrite, facts)

fence: No stand, no model, no network. Nothing is published here; the 0.5.2 upload and the tracy_setting.json switch are for a person to run.
